summary: Applies brightness, gamma, black level, range, step, and opacity adjustments while preserving hue and saturation more accurately than Level TOP for luma-focused work.

key_params.name: source
key_params.note: luminance, rgba channels, rgbaverage, or average source

key_params.name: blacklevel
key_params.note: Black level adjustment before range and step pages

common_gotchas: source=luminance adjusts luminance rather than independently changing raw RGB channels.
Range controls can crush blacks or whites if inlow/inhigh and outlow/outhigh are mismatched.
stepsize is inverse to the number of bands, so 0.25 gives four bands.
Post gamma and brightness are separate from the Pre page controls and happen later in the pipeline.
key_concepts: Adjusts luminance-like levels while preserving hue and saturation better than Level TOP for some controls.
The source menu scopes the lookup to luminance, a color channel, alpha, or channel averages.
Pre, Range, Step, and Post pages form an ordered lookup-based adjustment pipeline.
Step Size posterizes the result into bands whose count is the inverse of the step value.
The operator supports 3D Textures and 2D Texture Arrays.
